The camera stays static as he moves away from the center. (5) The scene cuts to the second player now in the catcher's position, viewed from the pitcher's perspective. He is crouching low as he receives a pitch with professional form. The text overlay indicates he is performing nice framing of the pitch. The background shows the expansive stadium interior and rows of empty seats under bright artificial lighting.
